title: Crispy Roasted Potatoes
description: Parboiled potato chunks tossed in oil and seasoning, then roasted at 425°F on a metal sheet pan until crisp.

ingredients.name: potatoes
ingredients.note: Yukon gold, red, or baby potatoes, cut into 1 to 1 1/4 inch chunks

steps.title: Parboil
steps.text: Place the potatoes in cold water salted with {boilsalt} and bring to a boil. Boil for 7 to 10 minutes until just barely tender.

steps.title: Steam off
steps.text: Drain well and let the potatoes steam off for 1 to 2 minutes so the surface dries.

steps.title: Season
steps.text: Toss the warm potatoes with {oil}, {salt}, {pepper}, {garlicpowder}, {paprika} and {cornstarch}.

steps.title: Spread
steps.text: Spread the potatoes on a metal sheet pan without crowding.

steps.title: Roast
steps.text: Roast at 425°F for 35 to 40 minutes, flipping once after about 20 minutes.

steps.title: Finish
steps.text: Toss with your choice of finish: melted butter and garlic powder, lemon and parsley, or parmesan.

notes: Parboiling roughens the outside of the potatoes so they crisp, and drying them before roasting matters as much as the oven. Timeline for a 5:40 PM dinner: 4:40 parboil, 4:55 season, 5:00 roast, 5:20 flip, 5:35 finish. Pairs with Chicken Smash Patties.
